posts.text:
Friday, Nov 20: Toronto's streetcars lost 982 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 511 Bathurst northbound. A typical 4.8 km trip lost 12 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 12 min over 7.8 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Friday's slowest spot: Westbound on Fleet St, approaching Fort York Blvd.
The average streetcar lost 1 min 49 s here (usually 1 min 46 s). Across 285 trips, that adds up to 8.7 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Fleet St around Fort York Blvd, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the westbound stretch at Fort York Blvd is highlighted, peaking at about 1 min 49 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Fleet St westbound, approaching Fort York Blvd
shot.sub: Friday, Nov 20: 1 min 49 s lost per streetcar · 285 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Friday, Nov 20: 507 Long Branch. 1 in 19 trips (10) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Lake Shore Blvd West at Kipling Ave (westbound, 10), instead of going on to Long Branch.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 507 Long Branch route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Lake Shore Blvd West at Kipling Ave, gives how many westbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Long Branch.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Friday, Nov 20: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

40% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 288 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 40% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Friday, Nov 20: at the busiest moment (5:00 pm), 152 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,031 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 95% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Friday, Nov 20, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 152 streetcars at 5:00 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Friday, Nov 20: Lake Shore Blvd West at Kipling Ave (507 Long Branch westbound).

Riders waited 17.6 min on average, against 5.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 12.7 min extra. 1 in 7 cars came bunched, and 20 of 102 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Lake Shore Blvd West at Kipling Ave in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 12.7 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
